What to look for: this should compile, and today it does. The link is here to
confirm the fix rather than to show the bug.

Expect clean SPIR-V with six OpString entries and a DebugPrintf import, and six
matching OpExtInst calls in main.

Note this now runs WITHOUT the "-fcgl -Vd" the issue used. That workaround
dodged a spirv-tools crash of the day; it is obsolete, and dropping it means
legalization and validation actually run here.

Compiler Explorer cannot show the failure: its oldest DXC is 1.6.2112, which
is already the release that fixed this. The crash was confined to 1.6.2104 and
1.6.2106, where it appeared as heap corruption on most but not all runs.
